title: Slice Culture Media
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science

steps_raw.instruction: Scope and Applicability: Slice Prep Media used for human or mouse slice culture.
MEM Eagle medium, Hanks salts + 2 mM L-glutamine (Sigma M4642 or equivalent)
Ascorbic Acid (Sigma A7506 or equivalent)
HEPES (VWR H3537 or equivalent)
NaHCO3, 892.75 mM solution (840 µl) (Gibco 25080-094 or equivalent)
D-glucose (563 µl) (Gibco A24940-01 or equivalent)
penicillin/streptomycin 5,000/L (Gibco 15070-063 or equivalent)
GlutaMAX I (Gibco 35050-061 or equivalent)
Calcium chloride dehydrate (Sigma C3306 or equivalent)
Magnesium sulfate heptahydrate (Sigma M1880 or equivalent)
Insulin from bovine pancreas, 10 mg/ml (Sigma I0516 or equivalent)
Horse serum-heat inactivated, 20 ml aliquots (Gibco 26050088 or equivalent)
500 ml graduated cylinder
5 ml Serological pipette
P200 pipette tips (Rainin GPL200F or equivalent)
P1000 tips (Rainin GPL1000F or equivalent)
250 ml sterile filter unit 0.22 µm PES (Sigma S2GPU02RE or equivalent)
Disposable plastic spatulas
Vacuum pump (Gast DOA-P104-AA or equivalent) with Tygon tubing
Osmometer (Fiske 210 or equivalent)
242 ml of Slice Culture Media, pH 7.2-7.3, Osmolarity 300-305 mOsm/kg
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Obtain a 500 ml beaker.
Obtain a stir bar and place it in the container.
Thaw premeasured (20-80 ml) heat-inactivated Horse serum in water bath.
Methodology/Procedures:
Determine the required amount of Slice Culture Media to prepare. Table 1 lists the reagents quantities required to make 121 ml, 242 ml, 363 ml or 484 ml of slice culture media.
Table 1. Reagents required to prepare Slice Culture Media
To make 242 ml of Slice Culture Media:
Using a graduated cylinder, measure 190 ml of MilliQ Water. Add the water to an appropriately labeled container containing a stir bar.
Place the container on a stir plate and begin stirring.
Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 1.68 g of MEM Eagle medium, Hanks salts + 2 mM L-glutamine. Slowly add weighed medium to the container while stirring.
Using a calibrated balance, weigh out 36 mg of Ascorbic Acid. Slowly add weighed ascorbic acid to the container while stirring.
Move container into the sterile hood to continue adding liquid reagents.
Using a serological pipette or P1000, add 6 ml of HEPES to the container. The solution should turn a pink color.
Using a serological pipette or a P1000, add 3.36 ml or 840 µl four times of NaHCO3, 892.75 mM solution to the container.
Using a serological pipette or P1000, add 2.25 ml or 750 µl three times of D-glucose to the container.
Using a P1000 pipette, add 1 ml of penicillin/streptomycin 5,000/L to the container.
Using a P1000 pipette, add 500 µl of GlutaMAX I to the container.
Using a P200 pipette, add 200 µl of 2 M MgSO4 to the container.
Using a P200 pipette, add 100 µl of 2 M CaCl2.2H2O to the container.
Using a P200 pipette, add 100 µl of Insulin from bovine pancreas, 10 mg/ml to the container.
Pour 40 ml of heat inactivated Horse serum into the container. Use a P200 to get remaining liquid in the tube and add to container.
Continue stirring until all the chemicals are fully in solution.
Using a calibrated pH meter, measure the pH of the slice culture media. Adjust the pH to 7.2-7.3 using 1 M Tris base.
Note: pH will equilibrate in the incubator over 24 hours.
Using a calibrated Osmometer, measure the osmolarity of a 10 µl sample of the media.
If the osmolarity is not 300-305 mOsm, recalibrate Osmometer and retest.
If the osmolarity is still out of range, you may need to remake the media.
Filter the slice culture media through a Millipore 250 ml 0.22 µm filter system in the hood.
Using Tygon tubing, attach the Millipore filter system to the Gast vacuum pump. Turn on the pump.
Label the bottle with reagent name, date, and preparer’s initials. Slice culture media expires two weeks from date of preparation. Do not use expired slice culture media.
Place in incubator at 35⁰C
Note: Slice culture media must be made 3 days prior to use.
Note: Slice culture medium expires after 2 weeks when stored at 35⁰C.
Spray down hood with 70% EtOH.
Wash the stir bar with MilliQ Water.
Place all used beakers and graduated cylinders in the dirty bins.
Reagent | 121 ml | 242 ml | 363 ml | 484 ml
MilliQ H2O | 95 ml | 190 ml | 285 ml | 380 ml

HEPES | 3 ml | 6 ml | 9 ml | 12 ml

penicillin/streptomycin 5,000/L | 500 µl | 1 ml | 1.5 ml | 2 ml
